Cover Story
Local girl turns 23 — entire heart of local man declared hers
By your Batooti · Exclusive · Filed with love

Happy 23rd Birthday, Gawhara. My elegant lady, my favorite little baby — I love you for every reason you gave me, and every reason you didn’t.

In my eyes there is a gem, a shining gem beyond all tales,
From desert sands to the heart you came, and nothing in me stayed the same,
Bambi eyes with soft deep stare, a thousand emotions hiding there,
Wallahi, you are art, divine and rare, no one alive can ever compare.
So here’s to you at twenty‑three, the girl who means the world to me,
and every year that’s left to be, I want you next to me.

Twenty‑three flowers and twenty‑three pictures, one for every year of you. Oh, and you won the game. Obviously.

— your Batooti ♥
